guarantees.claim: rand_update_o is continuously driven by keccak_rand_update
rand_consumed_o is continuously driven by keccak_rand_consumed
keccak_rand_data is continuously driven by rand_data_i

assumptions.claim: rand_data_i must be stable and valid while keccak_rand_update is asserted, until the consumer acknowledges via keccak_rand_consumed
assumptions.cond: during the random data update handshake
assumptions.risk: Stale or incorrect random data could be sampled, compromising entropy or Keccak round computations

uncertain_points.claim: The comment mentions a hardened round counter with SEC_CM: CTR.REDUN, but the actual counter logic is not present in this chunk; the redundancy of the round number counter must be verified in the enclosing logic.
uncertain_points.cond: when evaluating the security hardening of the Keccak round counter
uncertain_points.risk: If the round counter is not properly hardened or redundant, an attacker could disrupt the round sequence, leading to integrity failures in KMAC outputs
